title: Critique: cosmopsychism faces a de-combination problem

statements.text: Cosmopsychism only moves the explanatory gap: it seems conceivable that there is a conscious universe, with experience matching the structure of physics, and no conscious parts, while there are billions of human and animal subjects to explain. Miri Albahari named this the de-combination problem, and the subject, quality and structure problems of micropsychism return with the arrow of constitution reversed.
